text_block_list.text:
After safely finishing the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
I decided to have a Christmas party
with Mejiro McQueen.

After finishing up all the shopping
for the cake, food, and other supplies, we head back—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, Trainer, welcome back."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, judging by your reaction,
it seems you haven't realized it yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Actually, while you stepped away, Trainer-san,
I added one more decoration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What do you think?
Do you understand now?
Looking around the room once more—

A wrapped cookie is sitting neatly on the desk...!
What's more, it's shaped like the Tenno Sho shield!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It appears
you've come to understand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"It is a little small,
but I made the mold from scratch to model it after a shield."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To my Trainer, who led me to victory in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) following our spring triumph,
here is a small token of recognition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Please, savor every bite
of my respect for you."

I decided to try the handmade shield-shaped cookie
that Mejiro McQueen gave me.
—Or so it seemed, however.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What did you say...?! 
Let me have a bite too—
(*crunch*)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Indeed.
This is unmistakably burnt, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... And here I was hoping
to make you happy..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Really...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's quite right.
The feelings put into making it from scratch are genuine, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If even a fraction of my feelings came across,
that alone is more than enough for me.

Afterward, we let our hair down just a little bit more
than usual and enjoyed the Christmas party.

I decided to try the handmade shield-shaped cookie
that Mejiro McQueen gave me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, really...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness... It was well worth putting my heart
into making it from the mold."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, seeing your smile, Trainer,
put me at ease."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You have been putting your all toward
your goal this entire time, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Through effort, we were safely able
to achieve our goal, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because I've been pushing forward with single-minded devotion,
I felt as if even my private life was stretched taut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"So now that I've seen your smile,
I felt truly relieved knowing I could enjoy the event without any hesitation."
choice_data_list: Let's have a ton of fun from now on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes... By all means!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, let's prepare some glasses
and toast to our congratulations, shall we?

Afterward, we let loose and enjoyed the Christmas party
right up until curfew.
